state: **Side goal `one-temp-root`: stage 2 is done except the `icacls` item, and stage 3, the two runners, has not started.** No test code calls `std::env::temp_dir()` any more. `NOT_YET_MOVED` is gone from `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`, and `SUBJECT` is empty. **The `icacls` test gives this account its rights back from a guard's `Drop`**, so its folder is deleted even when it fails. Anchor: `crates/nvs-cli/tests/init.rs:466`.

The Unix arms of the socket sites compile only on Unix. Check them with `cargo clippy --all-targets` in WSL (`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl`), because the Windows `bun nv verify` does not reach them. Run them from the ext4 mirror (`syncMirror` in `tools/nv/driver/mirror.ts`): over `/mnt` a socket bind fails with `EOPNOTSUPP`.

In this worktree's WSL mirror, `/var/tmp/nvs-target-wsl-src/mnt-e-mwl-.agent-tmp-worktrees-side-one-temp-root`, every `nvs_repo::socket` path is about 121 bytes. Linux allows 107, so each socket test stops with the limit named. A checkout at the main path fits. The fix belongs to `mirrorPath` in `tools/nv/driver/mirror.ts`: a shorter mirror name.
`bun nv goal context --add` writes into the chain's live goal (`performance-pass`), never into a side goal run in a worktree. Edit a side goal's `context` by hand.
`bun nv verify`'s `extension` step fails in this worktree when the extension's npm dependencies are not installed (`.agent-tmp/verify-extension.log`).
